bundle.shortDescription: Floor plans, live 3D and an AI copilot for Philippine architects.
bundle.longDescription: Guhit Studio is a desktop design workspace for Philippine architects. Draw a semantic 2D floor plan, see it in 3D as you draw, ask the AI copilot for revisions you approve, and export client-ready plans and visuals. Projects are stored locally.
